verses.ar: مَزْمُورٌ أُغْنِيَةُ تَدْشِينِ اَلْبَيْتِ. لِدَاوُدَ أُعَظِّمُكَ يَارَبُّ لِأَنَّكَ نَشَلْتَنِي وَلَمْ تُشْمِتْ بِي أَعْدَائِي.
verses.kjv: A Psalm [and] Song [at] the dedication of the house of David. I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.web: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.kjv: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
verses.web: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، أَصْعَدْتَ مِنَ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ نَفْسِي. أَحْيَيْتَنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ ٱلْهَابِطِينَ فِي ٱلْجُبِّ.
verses.kjv: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.web: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.ar: رَنِّمُوا لِلرَّبِّ يَا أَتْقِيَاءَهُ، وَٱحْمَدُوا ذِكْرَ قُدْسِهِ.
verses.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.web: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ لِلَحْظَةٍ غَضَبَهُ. حَيَاةٌ فِي رِضَاهُ. عِنْدَ ٱلْمَسَاءِ يَبِيتُ ٱلْبُكَاءُ، وَفِي ٱلصَّبَاحِ تَرَنُّمٌ.
verses.kjv: For his anger [endureth but] a moment; in his favour [is] life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy [cometh] in the morning.
verses.web: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

verses.ar: وَأَنَا قُلْتُ فِي طُمَأْنِينَتِي: «لَا أَتَزَعْزَعُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ».
verses.kjv: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
verses.web: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، بِرِضَاكَ ثَبَّتَّ لِجَبَلِي عِزًّا. حَجَبْتَ وَجْهَكَ فَصِرْتُ مُرْتَاعًا.
verses.kjv: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, [and] I was troubled.
verses.web: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

verses.ar: إِلَيْكَ يَارَبُّ أَصْرُخُ، وإِلَى ٱلسَّيِّدِ أَتَضَرَّعُ
verses.kjv: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
verses.web: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:

verses.ar: مَا ٱلْفَائِدَةُ مِنْ دَمِي إِذَا نَزَلْتُ إِلَى ٱلْحُفْرَةِ؟ هَلْ يَحْمَدُكَ ٱلتُّرَابُ؟ هَلْ يُخْبِرُ بِحَقِّكَ؟
verses.kjv: What profit [is there] in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
verses.web: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

verses.ar: ٱسْتَمِعْ يَارَبُّ وَٱرْحَمْنِي. يَارَبُّ، كُنْ مُعِينًا لِي.
verses.kjv: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
verses.web: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”

verses.ar: حَوَّلْتَ نَوْحِي إِلَى رَقْصٍ لِي. حَلَلْتَ مِسْحِي وَمَنْطَقْتَنِي فَرَحًا،
verses.kjv: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.web: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

verses.ar: لِكَيْ تَتَرَنَّمَ لَكَ رُوحِي وَلَا تَسْكُتَ. يَارَبُّ إِلَهِي، إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ أَحْمَدُكَ.
verses.kjv: To the end that [my] glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
verses.web: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
